rules: Almost every move also adds 3 Steam Eruption. When the Waterfall Giant is killed while it has Steam Eruption, it becomes invulnerable and uses About To Blow, cleansing all its buffs and debuffs. Next turn it will use Explode, dealing damage equal to its accumulated Steam Eruption before dying.
If the Waterfall Giant is killed when it has no Steam Eruption (e.g. via Doom), it dies normally without triggering the explosion sequence.

Even though the HP bar in the last phase shows as "infinity", it is actually set to the finite number of 999,999,999 HP. As such, it is theoretically possible to kill the Waterfall Giant in its last phase.
If a card both deals damage and applies a debuff like Neutralize, the damage can kill the Waterfall Giant and activate About To Blow, then the debuff will be applied.
Waterfall Giant — Death Blow: Deals damage equal to its stored Steam Eruption amount, then dies.
